meta.promptText: Which brand's formal shirts should I buy for men in India?

response.text:
If you're buying **formal shirts for men in India**, I’d shortlist these brands:

| Brand | Best for | Typical sweet spot |
|---|---|---:|
| **Van Heusen** | Best overall / everyday office | ₹1,000–₹2,500 |
| **Louis Philippe** | Premium, polished look | ₹1,500–₹3,000 |
| **Arrow** | Classic corporate/formal | ₹1,500–₹3,500 |
| **Blackberrys** | Sharper, modern/slim fits | ₹1,200–₹3,000 |
| **Raymond** | Classic quality & traditional formals | ₹1,500–₹3,500 |
| **Park Avenue** | Good value for regular office wear | ₹800–₹2,000 |
| **Peter England** | Budget-friendly | ₹700–₹1,500 |


These brands are consistently among the stronger options in current Indian formalwear comparisons. [www.flickonclick.com](https://www.flickonclick.com/best-formal-shirt-brands/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

### My recommendation

**🥇 Van Heusen** — If you want just one brand, start here. It gives you a good balance of fit, professional styling and price. Current listings also show solid formal shirts around ₹840–₹1,000 during discounts.

### [Van Heusen Men Solid Formal]()
*₹840*

**🥈 Louis Philippe** — Spend a little more when you want the shirt to look noticeably more premium for client meetings, presentations or senior-office settings.

### [Louis Philippe Men's Textured Slim Fit Formal Shirt]()
*₹1,474*

**🥉 Park Avenue** — Excellent if you need several shirts without spending too much.

### [Park Avenue Men Striped Slim Fit Formal Shirt]()
*₹1,097*

### If I were building a wardrobe

I'd buy **5 shirts**:

- 2 × white
- 2 × light blue
- 1 × very subtle stripe/check

Go for **full sleeves**, minimal branding, and cotton/cotton-rich fabric. Most importantly, **fit matters more than the brand**—a well-fitting ₹1,000 shirt can look better than a poorly fitting ₹3,000 shirt. [www.flickonclick.com](https://www.flickonclick.com/best-formal-shirt-brands/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[midvey.com](https://midvey.com/blogs/news/top-10-best-formal-shirt-brands-in-india-for-2026?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**Best overall ranking:** **Van Heusen → Louis Philippe → Arrow → Blackberrys → Raymond → Park Avenue → Peter England.**

If you tell me your **budget per shirt (e.g. ₹1,000 / ₹2,000 / ₹3,000)** and whether you prefer **slim, regular, or relaxed fit**, I can narrow it down to the **best 3–5 shirts to buy right now**.
